author: steven5703
body:
Reason: Prior (telling people to kill their selfie)
When: This morning.
Staff: pelpelajax

My appeal:

Greetings
Recently I was banned for telling someone to kill their selfie. At the time, I did not know that saying kill your selfie was not allowed.

The admins made a post (https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/75819f5cf) saying there would be a one week grace period, where you would be warned, and then punished. Direct quote: "A one-week grace period will be in place where staff members should issue a warn before any punishment regarding these matters, but after it passes, immediate punishments will be given." However, I was PUNISHED immediately instead of being warned. You can't just say you won't punish people without a warning, and then punish me. Again, at the time I did not know that saying "kill yourselfie" wasn't allowed (I do now because of the official post and I was warned on teamspeak).

Also, kind of a side note, this ban WAS appealed but then I got rebanned. Doesn't that seem just a little bit unprofessional?
 
Thanks for reading.

title: My in game appeal.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello Steven,

Firstly, you were banned for prior because the wrong punishment was appealed, secondly you also quite literally told Timeless to hang him self (evidence https://gyazo.com/a7c292593d1a6695b58b70a54217b8e7). After talking to a Senior moderator, we decided that a 14 day was appropriate.

Regards,
Pelp.

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Steven,

The Senior Staff conducted a vote, and have collectively decided to keep your ban in place. Your behavior recently has been very childish and disrespectful. Comments such as these or these will not be tolerated in any form. Our post regarding suicide encouragement is not a new rule, but simply a reminder that behavior like such will not be tolerated. Your infraction will not be appealed, you will have to wait out your ban time. Thanks.

Regards,
Senior Staff
